d:
Shri hanumanashtak aadity garhvi ke bhavyukt svar men. sankatmochan hanumanashtak ki sanrachna gosvami tulsidas ne ki thi. mana jata hai ki sankatmochan hanumanashtak ka path karne se vyakti apni har badha aur pira se mukt ho jata hai aur uske sabhi sankat dur ho jate hain.
Watch the video song of "Hey Ram Awadh Ke Raja Tujhe Konsi Duvidha Ghere" now!
Jab shri ram ko apne guptachar se pata chalta hai ki praja mata sita ko lekar kaisi vichar dharna rakhte hain to unhen bahut duhkh hota hai parantu ye bat vo kisi se kah nahin sakte the jise soch kar vo bahut dukhi rakhne lage the.
